name: PT Jasuindo Tiga Perkasa Tbk
summary: PT Jasuindo Tiga Perkasa Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, operates in the security printing industry in Indonesia. The company operates in two segments, Security and Non-Security. It offers payment products, including cheque, bank cards, and other payment products; brand protection products comprising security and specialty packaging, security voucher and coupon, and tax stamps; commercial printing products, such as promoplus, gameplus, pin mailers, reel printing, insurance policy, billing statement, and delivery orders; and identity documents consisting of passports, identity cards, inlays, driver's license, and certificate/diploma.
